proceedings.supporting_quote: By a judgment of 30 June 2017 a Dutch-language division of the Court of Appeal held that the Aliens Appeals Boards’ judgment of 20 October 2016 was no longer operative
On 27 February 2017 the Belgian State lodged an appeal on points of law against the court of appeal’s judgment of 7 December 2016. Those proceedings are currently pending.
on an appeal by the Belgian State, the court of appeal varied the decision of the first-instance court in a judgment of 14 December 2016
On the same date the Conseil d’État dismissed an appeal on points of law brought by the Belgian State against the judgment of 7 October 2016
the Belgian State brought proceedings against the applicants before the enforcement judge at the Brussels Dutch-language TPI
On 20 December 2017 the French-language enforcement judge... found that the case had become devoid of purpose
lodged a unilateral action to that effect with the President of the Brussels Dutch-speaking TPI on 13 December 2016, but was unsuccessful
On 7 November 2016 another judge acting as president of the French-language TPI declared their application admissible but unfounded
By an order of 25 October 2016... the acting president of the French-language TPI ordered the State... to comply with the Board’s judgment of 20 October 2016
the Brussels Court of Appeal delivered a judgment on 7 December 2016 varying the order of 7 November 2016
An administrative appeal on points of law lodged by the applicants against that judgment was dismissed by the Conseil d’État on 17 May 2018
An appeal on points of law against this judgment was dismissed by the Conseil d’État in a judgment of 17 May 2018
On 8 February 2018 the Conseil d’État dismissed an appeal on points of law by the applicants against the judgment of 6 March 2017
On 6 March 2017 the Aliens Appeals Board... decided in consequence to lift the stay of execution
On 24 March 2017 the Aliens Appeals Board dismissed the application to have those decisions set aside
By a judgment of 24 March 2017 the Aliens Appeals Board dismissed the application to have the decisions set aside
On 7 October 2016 the Aliens Appeals Board... ordered a stay of execution of the refusals
By a judgment of 14 October 2016 the Aliens Appeals Board... again ordered a stay of execution
By a judgment of 20 October 2016 the Aliens Appeals Board... ordered a stay of execution of the refusal decisions of 17 October 2016
On 13 September 2016 the Aliens Office... refused to grant “humanitarian visas” to the applicants
the Aliens Office issued new decisions, dated 10 October 2016, refusing to grant the visas
On 17 October 2016 the Aliens Office again took decisions refusing to issue the visas
